$comment: The source repositories the site reads at build time: the build pins. They start at the commit the hand-written copy was verified against (docs/SOURCES.md records that commit, which stays put); scripts/sources/fetch.mjs clones them into .sources/<name> at exactly these commits; a repository marked "follow": "release" is then proposed for repin to its latest published GitHub release by scripts/sources/refresh.mjs, as a pull request from .github/workflows/sources-refresh.yml that the maintainer merges, never to a bare tag and never backwards; scripts/sources/collect.mjs refuses a checkout whose HEAD differs unless BANKAI_SOURCES_ALLOW_DRIFT=1. Every command, version, count, skill, agent and changelog the site shows is read from these trees; see docs/SOURCES.md for the per-claim citation list.
